whyDifferent.title: Why Are We Different?
whyDifferent.subtitle: Discover what makes us unique in the auto detailing market
whyDifferent.absoluteComfortDesc: We come to you. No need to leave your home or office.
whyDifferent.timeSavingDesc: Avoid waiting in car wash tunnels. We do the work while you continue with your day.
whyDifferent.premiumProductsDesc: We use only the highest quality products for every surface of your vehicle.
whyDifferent.multiStageDesc: Deep cleaning with specialized products for every type of dirt.
whyDifferent.advancedProtectionDesc: We apply sealants and protectants to keep your car flawless for longer.
whyDifferent.personalizedDesc: Every service is adapted to the specific needs of your vehicle.

alternating.whoIAmIntro: Creator of systems. Detailer by craft.
alternating.whoIAmText1: I believe in first-class service, executed at the highest level
alternating.whoIAmText2: I design and execute every service as a system:
alternating.whoIAmHighlight: process, technique, timing, and detail working in harmony.
alternating.whyUsText1: I use the best products in each category, for every material and surface.
alternating.whyUsText2: Selected from the world's leading brands and applied with proven, safe methods.
alternating.whyUsLi2: Every chemical, tool, and technique has a purpose.
alternating.whyUsHighlight: Top-tier products. World-class procedures. Genuine care — never rushed, never automated.
alternating.whyUsTagline: Not the cheapest. Simply the best — because true excellence should never be compromised.
alternating.fundamentalsText1: The goal is simple: to deliver the best service of your life.
alternating.fundamentalsText2: I don't sell services — I deliver real care. If you trust me with your car, I will never fail you.
alternating.fundamentalsText3: You'll receive a level of service better than you imagined, because excellence is a responsibility.
alternating.fundamentalsTagline: Trust is not taken lightly. And it's never broken.

vipUltimate.title: The Ultimate Luxury Experience
vipUltimate.desc: It's not just detailing, it's a complete artisan restoration over 48 hours under controlled lighting. Surgical-grade equipment, the most expensive sealants on the planet, and attention that borders on obsession.
vipUltimate.f4: Interior detailing with original texture restoration

vipUltimate.surpriseDesc: An exclusive detail that will arrive at your door after the service.

vipPhilosophy.title: Why do we do this?
vipPhilosophy.p: We were born from a passion for the details that others overlook. We don't care about time, we care about results. We created the VIP level because we know there are cars that aren't just machines, but extensions of their owners' souls.
